profile.headline: Director of Information at Missing Link Electronics
profile.summary:
I am a long time UNIX programmer.  I was one of the first members of the Home Brew Computer Club. I was part of David Patterson's class that defined the RISC term and the RISC I and II processors. I worked for the Computer Systems Research Group at the University of California, Berkeley on the 4.2 through 4.4 BSD releases.
My home programming interests are in Natural Language Understanding and processing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the UVM Linux kernel driver and added the HMM support for older GPUs to allow malloc() and mmap() memory allocations to be used instead of calling cudaMallocManaged(). This matches the programming model for NVIDIA's newer coherent memory systems with hardware support for accessing system memory without using the cuda memory allocators.

positions.title: entrepreneur & co-founder
positions.description: Started up and ran RISC Systems with Jim Peek. We designed, built and sold advanced processors for high-end workstations (for Mech Engineering & CADCAM). We became profitable after 1 year of development, then operated at that level for 2 years (mfg, sales & service). It was a great experience to "do it all"
